4416   /**
4417    * Implements {@link ConversionFinder} to provide all MarshallingContext-specific type conversions that cannot
4418    * be expressed in {@link BasicConverter} (which has no dependency on {@code juneau-marshall}).
4419    *
4420    * <p>
4421    * Conversions are resolved in this priority order:
4422    * <ol>
4423    *    <li>ObjectSwap-based conversions (highest priority)
4424    *    <li>Iso8601 date/time formatting and parsing
4425    *    <li>Epoch-millis to date/time
4426    *    <li>Map/Bean/Collection/Array to String via serializer
4427    *    <li>String/CharSequence to Array, Map, Collection via JSON parsing
4428    *    <li>Map to Bean and String to Bean via BeanMap
4429    *    <li>Calendar/Date specialized copies
4430    *    <li>InputStream and Reader construction
4431    * </ol>
4432    *
4433    * @param inType The input type class.
4434    * @param outType The output type class.
4435    * @return A matching {@link Conversion}, or {@code null} if none applies.
4436    */
4437   @Override
4438   @SuppressWarnings({
4439      "java:S6541", // Brain Method: conversion dispatch inherently requires handling many type pairs in one place
4440      "null" // `builder` is guarded by `nn(builder)` before access; Eclipse doesn't recognise `nn()` as a null-check function.
4441   })
4442   public Conversion<?,?> findConversion(Class<?> inType, Class<?> outType) {
4443      var toMeta = getClassMeta(outType);
4444      var fromMeta = getClassMeta(inType);
4445
4446      // --- ObjectSwap conversions (must come first) ---
4447      for (var swap : objectSwaps) {
4448         var nc = swap.getNormalClass().inner();
4449         var fc = swap.getSwapClass().inner();
4450         // Unswap: input is swap class (or convertible to it), output is normal class
4451         if (nc.isAssignableFrom(outType) && (fc.isAssignableFrom(inType) || Map.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) || Number.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))) {
4452            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4453               try {
4454                  var bs = marshallingSession(session);
4455                  var resolvedSwap = bs != null ? toMeta.getSwap(bs) : null;
4456                  var activeSwap = (ObjectSwap<Object,Object>) or(resolvedSwap, swap);
4457                  var swapClass = activeSwap.getSwapClass().inner();
4458                  // Direct match
4459                  if (swapClass.isInstance(in))
4460                     return activeSwap.unswap(bs, in, toMeta);
4461                  // Intermediate Map conversion
4462                  if (Map.class.isAssignableFrom(swapClass) && in instanceof Map)
4463                     return activeSwap.unswap(bs, converter.to(in, memberOf, bs, swapClass), toMeta);
4464                  // Intermediate Number conversion
4465                  if (Number.class.isAssignableFrom(swapClass) && in instanceof Number)
4466                     return activeSwap.unswap(bs, converter.to(in, memberOf, bs, swapClass), toMeta);
4467                  // The swap's own swap-class is shaped like neither Map nor Number, so it doesn't apply to
4468                  // this input -- but if the input is already a Map matching toMeta's own Map shape, copy
4469                  // its entries directly rather than dropping the value.
4470                  return copyMapEntries(toMeta, in);
4471               } catch (Exception e) {
4472                  throw rex(e);
4473               }
4474            };
4475         }
4476         // Swap: input is normal class, output is swap class
4477         if (nc.isAssignableFrom(inType) && fc.isAssignableFrom(outType)) {
4478            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4479               try {
4480                  var bs = marshallingSession(session);
4481                  return ((ObjectSwap<Object,Object>) swap).swap(bs, in);
4482               } catch (Exception e) {
4483                  throw rex(e);
4484               }
4485            };
4486         }
4487      }
4488
4489      // --- Inline/auto-detected swaps from ClassMeta (e.g. AutoNumberSwap, AutoObjectSwap) ---
4490      // These are swaps found on the class itself (via swap() methods, toXxx() patterns, etc.)
4491      // and not registered in the objectSwaps list.
4492      var toSwap = toMeta.getSwap(null);
4493      if (toSwap != null) {
4494         // Use boxed version of swap class to handle primitive swap types (e.g. toInt() → int.class → Integer.class)
4495         var fcBoxed = info(toSwap.getSwapClass().inner()).getWrapperIfPrimitive().inner();
4496         if (fcBoxed.isAssignableFrom(inType) || Map.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) || Number.class.isAssignableFrom(inType)) {
4497            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4498               try {
4499               var bs = marshallingSession(session);
4500               var activeSwap = (ObjectSwap<Object,Object>) toMeta.getSwap(bs);
4501                  if (activeSwap == null) return null;
4502                  // Use boxed swap class to handle primitive return types (e.g. int.class → Integer.class)
4503                  var swapClass = info(activeSwap.getSwapClass().inner()).getWrapperIfPrimitive().inner();
4504                  if (swapClass.isInstance(in))
4505                     return activeSwap.unswap(bs, in, toMeta);
4506                  if (Map.class.isAssignableFrom(swapClass) && in instanceof Map)
4507                     return activeSwap.unswap(bs, converter.to(in, memberOf, bs, swapClass), toMeta);
4508                  if (Number.class.isAssignableFrom(swapClass) && in instanceof Number)
4509                     return activeSwap.unswap(bs, converter.to(in, memberOf, bs, swapClass), toMeta);
4510                  // See the analogous fallback in the objectSwaps loop above.
4511                  return copyMapEntries(toMeta, in);
4512               } catch (Exception e) {
4513                  throw rex(e);
4514               }
4515            };
4516         }
4517      }
4518      var fromSwap = fromMeta.getSwap(null);
4519      if (fromSwap != null) {
4520         var fcBoxed = info(fromSwap.getSwapClass().inner()).getWrapperIfPrimitive().inner();
4521         if (fcBoxed.isAssignableFrom(outType) || outType == Object.class) {
4522            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4523               try {
4524               var bs = marshallingSession(session);
4525               var activeSwap = (ObjectSwap<Object,Object>) fromMeta.getSwap(bs);
4526                  if (activeSwap == null) return null;
4527                  return activeSwap.swap(bs, in);
4528               } catch (Exception e) {
4529                  throw rex(e);
4530               }
4531            };
4532         }
4533      }
4534
4535      // --- Date/time → CharSequence via Iso8601Utils (Gap 5) ---
4536      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(outType) && (fromMeta.isDateOrCalendarOrTemporal() || fromMeta.isDuration()))
4537         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> Iso8601Utils.format(in, fromMeta, sessionTimeZone(session));
4538
4539      // --- CharSequence → date/time via Iso8601Utils (Gap 6) ---
4540      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && (toMeta.isDateOrCalendarOrTemporal() || toMeta.isDuration()))
4541         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> Iso8601Utils.parse(in.toString(), toMeta, sessionTimeZone(session));
4542
4543      // --- Number → date/time via epoch millis (Gap 7) ---
4544      if (Number.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && toMeta.isDateOrCalendarOrTemporal())
4545         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> Iso8601Utils.fromEpochMillis(((Number)in).longValue(), toMeta, sessionTimeZone(session));
4546
4547      // --- Map/Bean/Collection/Array/Optional → String via serializer (Gap 14) ---
4548      if (outType == String.class) {
4549         // byte[] → String must come before isCollectionOrArrayOrOptional since byte[] is an array type
4550         if (byte[].class == inType)
4551            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> new String((byte[]) in, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
4552         if (fromMeta.isMapOrBean() || fromMeta.isCollectionOrArrayOrOptional()) {
4553            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4554               try {
4555                  var ws = getBeanToStringSerializer();
4556                  return ws != null ? ws.write(in) : in.toString();
4557               } catch (Exception e) {
4558                  throw rex(e);
4559               }
4560            };
4561         }
4562         if (Class.class == inType)
4563            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> ((Class<?>) in).getName();
4564      }
4565
4566      // --- CharSequence → Array via JSON parsing (Gap 10) ---
4567      // Excludes byte[] since that is handled by BasicConverter.findSpecialConversion (getBytes(UTF_8)).
4568      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && outType.isArray() && outType != byte[].class) {
4569         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4570            try {
4571               var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4572               var str = in.toString();
4573               Json5List list;
4574               if (startsWith(str, '['))
4575                  list = Json5List.ofString(str).setBeanSession(bs);
4576               else
4577                  list = new Json5List((Object[]) splita(str)).setBeanSession(bs);
4578               return bs.convertToType(list, outType);
4579            } catch (Exception e) {
4580               throw rex(e);
4581            }
4582         };
4583      }
4584
4585      // --- CharSequence → Map via JSON parsing (Gap 11) ---
4586      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && Map.class.isAssignableFrom(outType) && !toMeta.canCreateNewInstanceFromString(null)) {
4587         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4588            try {
4589               var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4590               var m = Json5Map.ofString(in.toString());
4591               m.setBeanSession(bs);
4592               return bs.convertToType(m, outType);
4593            } catch (Exception e) {
4594               throw rex(e);
4595            }
4596         };
4597      }
4598
4599      // --- Collection/Array → Collection with session-aware element conversion ---
4600      // When the target is an abstract collection type (List, Collection), uses JsonList instead of ArrayList
4601      // to preserve the session-aware default behavior from the original convertToCollectionType.
4602      if ((Collection.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) || inType.isArray()) && Collection.class.isAssignableFrom(outType)) {
4603         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4604            // Treat Object.class as "no element type" (untyped/raw, needs no element conversion).
4605            var elemType = args.length > 0 && args[0] != Object.class ? (Class<?>) args[0] : null;
4606            if (elemType == null && !inType.isArray() && outType.isAssignableFrom(in.getClass()))
4607               return in;
4608            var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4609            Collection<Object> result;
4610            if (outType.isAssignableFrom(JsonList.class)) {
4611               result = new JsonList(bs);  // Use JsonList for abstract types (List, Collection, Iterable)
4612            } else {
4613               result = newCollection(outType);
4614            }
4615            if (in instanceof Collection<?> col2) {
4616               for (var elem : col2)
4617                  result.add(elemType != null ? converter.to(elem, memberOf, session, elemType) : elem);
4618            } else {
4619               var len = Array.getLength(in);
4620               for (var i = 0; i < len; i++) {
4621                  var elem = Array.get(in, i);
4622                  result.add(elemType != null ? converter.to(elem, memberOf, session, elemType) : elem);
4623               }
4624            }
4625            return result;
4626         };
4627      }
4628
4629      // --- Map → Collection (wraps map as single element, preserving old convertToCollectionType behavior) ---
4630      if (Map.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && Collection.class.isAssignableFrom(outType)) {
4631         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4632            var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4633            Collection<Object> result;
4634            if (outType.isAssignableFrom(JsonList.class)) {
4635               result = new JsonList(bs);
4636            } else {
4637               result = newCollection(outType);
4638            }
4639            var elemType = args.length > 0 && args[0] != Object.class ? (Class<?>) args[0] : null;
4640            result.add(elemType != null ? converter.to(in, memberOf, session, elemType) : in);
4641            return result;
4642         };
4643      }
4644
4645      // --- CharSequence → Collection via JSON parsing (Gap 12) ---
4646      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && Collection.class.isAssignableFrom(outType)) {
4647         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4648            try {
4649               var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4650               var str = in.toString();
4651               if (!isProbablyJsonArray(str, false))
4652                  throw rex("Cannot convert string to %s: %s", outType.getName(), str);
4653               var elemType = args.length > 0 ? args[0] : null;
4654               var l2 = Json5List.ofString(str).setBeanSession(bs);
4655               var result = newCollection(outType);
4656               l2.forEach(x -> result.add(elemType != null && x != null ? converter.to(x, elemType) : x));
4657               return result;
4658            } catch (Exception e) {
4659               throw rex(e);
4660            }
4661         };
4662      }
4663
4664      // --- Map → Bean via BeanMap/BuilderSwap/BeanRegistry (Gap 17) ---
4665      if (Map.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && toMeta.isBean()) {
4666         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4667            try {
4668               var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4669               var m2 = (Map<?,?>) in;
4670               var builder = (BuilderSwap<Object,Object>) toMeta.getBuilderSwap(bs);
4671               if (m2 instanceof MarshalledMap mm && builder == null) {
4672                  var typeName = mm.getString(bs.getBeanTypePropertyName(toMeta));
4673                  if (nn(typeName)) {
4674                     var cm = toMeta.getBeanRegistry().getClassMeta(typeName);
4675                     if (nn(cm) && toMeta.isAssignableFrom(cm.inner()))
4676                        return mm.cast(cm);
4677                  }
4678               }
4679               if (nn(builder)) {
4680                  var created = builder.create(bs, toMeta);
4681                  if (created != null) {
4682                     var bm = bs.toBeanMap(created);
4683                     bm.load(m2);
4684                     return builder.build(bs, checkRequired(bs, bm).getBean(), toMeta);
4685                  }
4686               }
4687               return checkRequired(bs, bs.newBeanMap(toMeta.inner()).load(m2)).getBean();
4688            } catch (Exception e) {
4689               var mrpe = MissingRequiredPropertyException.find(e);
4690               throw nn(mrpe) ? mrpe : rex(e);
4691            }
4692         };
4693      }
4694
4695      // --- CharSequence → URL (URL(String) is deprecated in Java 20+, use URI.create().toURL() instead) ---
4696      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && outType == URL.class)
4697         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4698            try {
4699               return new URI(in.toString()).toURL();
4700            } catch (Exception e) {
4701               throw rex(e);
4702            }
4703         };
4704
4705      // --- CharSequence → Bean via BeanMap (Gap 21) ---
4706      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && toMeta.isBean()) {
4707         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4708            try {
4709               var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4710               return BeanMapLoader.load(bs.newBeanMap(toMeta.inner()), in.toString()).getBean();
4711            } catch (Exception e) {
4712               throw rex(e);
4713            }
4714         };
4715      }
4716
4717      // --- Calendar/Date specialized conversions (Gap 19) ---
4718      if (toMeta.isCalendar()) {
4719         if (Calendar.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))
4720            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4721               var c = (Calendar) in;
4722               var c2 = new GregorianCalendar(c.getTimeZone());
4723               c2.setTime(c.getTime());
4724               return c2;
4725            };
4726         if (Date.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))
4727            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4728               var c2 = new GregorianCalendar(TimeZone.getDefault());
4729               c2.setTime((Date) in);
4730               return c2;
4731            };
4732         if (Temporal.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))
4733            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4734               var temporal = (Temporal) in;
4735               Instant instant;
4736               try {
4737               instant = Instant.from(temporal);
4738               } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") DateTimeException e) {
4739               // LocalDateTime lacks offset info - interpret using session/system timezone
4740               var tz = sessionTimeZone(session);
4741               var zoneId = tz != null ? tz.toZoneId() : ZoneId.systemDefault();
4742               instant = LocalDateTime.from(temporal).atZone(zoneId).toInstant();
4743            }
4744            return Iso8601Utils.fromEpochMillis(instant.toEpochMilli(), toMeta, sessionTimeZone(session));
4745            };
4746      }
4747      if (toMeta.isDate() && outType == Date.class) {
4748         if (Calendar.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))
4749            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> ((Calendar) in).getTime();
4750         if (Temporal.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))
4751            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4752               var temporal = (Temporal) in;
4753               Instant instant;
4754               try {
4755               instant = Instant.from(temporal);
4756               } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") DateTimeException e) {
4757               // LocalDateTime lacks offset info - interpret using session/system timezone
4758               var tz = sessionTimeZone(session);
4759               var zoneId = tz != null ? tz.toZoneId() : ZoneId.systemDefault();
4760               instant = LocalDateTime.from(temporal).atZone(zoneId).toInstant();
4761            }
4762            return Date.from(instant);
4763            };
4764      }
4765
4766      // --- byte[]/CharSequence → InputStream (Gap 18) ---
4767      if (InputStream.class.isAssignableFrom(outType)) {
4768         if (byte[].class == inType)
4769            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> { var b = (byte[]) in; return new ByteArrayInputStream(b, 0, b.length); };
4770         if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))
4771            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> { var b = in.toString().getBytes(); return new ByteArrayInputStream(b, 0, b.length); };
4772      }
4773
4774      // --- byte[]/CharSequence → Reader (Gap 18) ---
4775      if (Reader.class.isAssignableFrom(outType)) {
4776         if (byte[].class == inType)
4777            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> new StringReader(new String((byte[]) in));
4778         if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType))
4779            return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> new StringReader(in.toString());
4780      }
4781
4782      // --- CharSequence → Enum using ClassMeta (respects ignoreUnknownEnumValues) (Gap 13) ---
4783      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && outType.isEnum()) {
4784         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4785            try {
4786               return toMeta.newInstanceFromString(memberOf, in.toString());
4787            } catch (Exception e) {
4788               throw rex(e);
4789            }
4790         };
4791      }
4792
4793      // --- CharSequence → CharSequence subtype via ClassMeta (Gap 15) ---
4794      if (CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && toMeta.isCharSequence() && outType != String.class && toMeta.canCreateNewInstanceFromString(null)) {
4795         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4796            try {
4797               return toMeta.newInstanceFromString(memberOf, in.toString());
4798            } catch (Exception e) {
4799               throw rex(e);
4800            }
4801         };
4802      }
4803
4804      // --- Array → CharSequence subtype via serializer (Gap 15) ---
4805      if (inType.isArray() && toMeta.isCharSequence() && outType != String.class && toMeta.canCreateNewInstanceFromString(null)) {
4806         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4807            try {
4808               var ws = getBeanToStringSerializer();
4809               var str = ws != null ? ws.write(in) : in.toString();
4810               return toMeta.newInstanceFromString(memberOf, str);
4811            } catch (Exception e) {
4812               throw rex(e);
4813            }
4814         };
4815      }
4816
4817      // --- Enum → T via toString() (allows Enum→Boolean, Enum→Number, etc.) ---
4818      // Excludes Enum→Enum (handled by BasicConverter) and Enum→String (handled by BasicConverter/CharSequence path).
4819      if (inType.isEnum() && !outType.isEnum() && !CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(outType)) {
4820         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> converter.to(in.toString(), memberOf, session, outType, args);
4821      }
4822
4823      // --- Object → Boolean via toString() (lenient: any non-"true" string is false) ---
4824      // Excludes CharSequence types (handled by BasicConverter), primitives (handled by CachingConverter nullDefault),
4825      // and types that BasicConverter already handles (e.g. via toBoolean() instance method).
4826      if ((outType == Boolean.class || outType == boolean.class) && !CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && !Number.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && inType != boolean.class && inType != Boolean.class && !BasicConverter.INSTANCE.canConvert(inType, Boolean.class)) {
4827         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> converter.to(in.toString(), memberOf, session, Boolean.class);
4828      }
4829
4830   // --- Object → Bean via toString() + BeanMap.load() (fallback for bean-compatible types) ---
4831   // Replicates the old convertToMemberType fallback for beans (newBeanMap + load + getBean).
4832   // Excludes cases where input is already assignable to output (handled by MarshallingSession isInstance shortcut).
4833      if (toMeta.isBean() && !Map.class.isAssignableFrom(inType) && !CharSequence.class.isAssignableFrom(inType)
4834            && !outType.isAssignableFrom(inType)) {
4835         return (in, memberOf, session, args) -> {
4836            try {
4837               var bs = beanSessionOrDefault(session);
4838               return BeanMapLoader.load(bs.newBeanMap(toMeta.inner()), in.toString()).getBean();
4839            } catch (Exception e) {
4840               throw rex(e);
4841            }
4842         };
4843      }
4844
4845      return null;
4846   }

4860   private static Collection<Object> newCollection(Class<?> outType) {
4861      if (outType == List.class || outType == Collection.class || outType == Iterable.class || outType == AbstractList.class)
4862         return l();
4863      if (outType == Set.class || outType == LinkedHashSet.class || outType == AbstractSet.class)
4864         return new LinkedHashSet<>();
4865      if (outType == SortedSet.class || outType == NavigableSet.class || outType == TreeSet.class)
4866         return new TreeSet<>();
4867      try {
4868         return (Collection<Object>) outType.getDeclaredConstructor().newInstance();
4869      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") Exception e) {
4870         return l();
4871      }
4872   }

4925   /**
4926    * Used to resolve <c>ClassMetas</c> of type <c>Collection</c> and <c>Map</c> that have
4927    * <c>ClassMeta</c> values that themselves could be collections or maps.
4928    *
4929    * <p>
4930    * <c>Collection</c> meta objects are assumed to be followed by zero or one meta objects indicating the element type.
4931    *
4932    * <p>
4933    * <c>Map</c> meta objects are assumed to be followed by zero or two meta objects indicating the key and value types.
4934    *
4935    * <p>
4936    * The array can be arbitrarily long to indicate arbitrarily complex data structures.
4937    *
4938    * <h4 class='section'>Examples:</h4>
4939    * <ul>
4940    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(String.<jk>class</jk>);</code> - A normal type.
4941    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(List.<jk>class</jk>);</code> - A list containing objects.
4942    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(List.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>);</code> - A list containing strings.
4943    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(LinkedList.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>);</code> - A linked-list containing
4944    *       strings.
4945    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(LinkedList.<jk>class</jk>, LinkedList.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>);</code> -
4946    *       A linked-list containing linked-lists of strings.
4947    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(Map.<jk>class</jk>);</code> - A map containing object keys/values.
4948    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(Map.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>);</code> - A map
4949    *       containing string keys/values.
4950    *    <li><code>getClassMeta(Map.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>, List.<jk>class</jk>, MyBean.<jk>class</jk>);</code> -
4951    *       A map containing string keys and values of lists containing beans.
4952    * </ul>
4953    *
4954    * @param <T>
4955    *    The class to resolve.
4956    * @param type
4957    *    The class to resolve.
4958    *    <br>Can be any of the following: {@link ClassMeta}, {@link ClassInfo}, {@link Class}, {@link ParameterizedType}, {@link GenericArrayType}
4959    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <jk>null</jk>).
4960    * @param args
4961    *    The type arguments of the class if it's a collection or map.
4962    *    <br>Can be any of the following: {@link ClassMeta}, {@link ClassInfo}, {@link Class}, {@link ParameterizedType}, {@link GenericArrayType}
4963    *    <br>Ignored if the main type is not a map or collection.
4964    * @return The resolved class meta, or <jk>null</jk> if the type was <jk>null</jk>.
4965    */
4966   public final <T> ClassMeta<T> getClassMeta(Type type, Type...args) {
4967      if (type == null)
4968         return null;
4969      ClassMeta<T> cm = null;
4970      if (type instanceof Class type2)
4971         cm = getClassMeta(type2);
4972      else
4973         cm = resolveClassMeta(type, null);
4974      if (args.length == 0)
4975         return cm;
4976      var cma = new ClassMeta<?>[args.length + 1];
4977      cma[0] = cm;
4978      for (var i = 0; i < length(args); i++) {
4979         var arg = (Type)Array.get(args, i);
4980         if (arg instanceof Class arg2)
4981            cma[i + 1] = getClassMeta(arg2);
4982         else
4983            cma[i + 1] = resolveClassMeta(arg, null);
4984      }
4985      return (ClassMeta<T>)getTypedClassMeta(cma, 0);
4986   }

4988   /**
4989    * Returns the {@link ClassMeta} for the object's class, unwrapping recognized proxies first.
4990    *
4991    * <p>
4992    * Same contract as {@link MarshallingSession#getClassMetaForObject(Object, ClassMeta)}:
4993    * {@link org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.ClassUtils#getProxyFor(Object)} if non-<jk>null</jk>,
4994    * else {@code o.getClass()}. Used by object-tools and other context callers; parsers do not
4995    * call this method.

4997    * @param <T> The class of the object being passed in.
4998    * @param o The object to find the class type for.

5000    * @return The ClassMeta object.
5001    */
5002   public final <T> ClassMeta<T> getClassMetaForObject(T o) {
5003      reqnn("o", o);
5004      var unwrapped = getProxyFor(o);
5005      Class<?> k = unwrapped != null ? unwrapped : o.getClass();
5006      return (ClassMeta<T>)getClassMeta(k);
5007   }

5616   /**
5617    * Used for determining the class type on a method or field where a {@code @BeanProp} annotation may be present.
5618    *
5619    * @param <T> The class type we're wrapping.
5620    * @param p The property annotation info on the type if there is one.
5621    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (the class type is resolved from <c>ci</c> alone, with no <ja>@BeanProp</ja>-based narrowing).
5622    * @param ci The class info for the type.
5623    * @param typeVarImpls
5624    *    Contains known resolved type parameters on the specified class so that we can result
5625    *    {@code ParameterizedTypes} and {@code TypeVariables}.
5626    *    Can be <jk>null</jk> if the information is not known.
5627    * @return The new {@code ClassMeta} object wrapped around the type.
5628    */
5629   protected final <T> ClassMeta<T> resolveClassMeta(AnnotationInfo<BeanProp> p, ClassInfo ci, TypeVariables typeVarImpls) {
5630      var cm = resolveClassMeta(ci, typeVarImpls);
5631      var cm2 = cm;
5632
5633      if (nn(p)) {
5634         var beanp = p.inner();
5635
5636         if (isNotVoid(beanp.type()))
5637            cm2 = resolveClassMeta(beanp.type(), typeVarImpls);
5638
5639         if (cm2.isMap()) {
5640            var pParams = (beanp.params().length == 0 ? a(Object.class, Object.class) : beanp.params());
5641            if (pParams.length != 2)
5642               throw rex("Invalid number of parameters specified for Map (must be 2): %s", pParams.length);
5643            var keyType = resolveType(pParams[0], cm2.getKeyType(), cm.getKeyType());
5644            var valueType = resolveType(pParams[1], cm2.getValueType(), cm.getValueType());
5645            if (keyType.isObject() && valueType.isObject())
5646               return cm2;
5647            return new ClassMeta<>(cm2, keyType, valueType, null);
5648         }
5649
5650         if (cm2.isCollection() || cm2.isOptional()) {
5651            var pParams = (beanp.params().length == 0 ? a(Object.class) : beanp.params());
5652            if (pParams.length != 1) {
5653               String typeName;
5654               if (cm2.isCollection()) {
5655                  typeName = "Collection";
5656               } else if (cm2.isOptional()) {
5657                  typeName = "Optional";
5658               } else {
5659                  typeName = "Array";
5660               }
5661               throw rex("Invalid number of parameters specified for %2$s (must be 1): %1$s", pParams.length, typeName);
5662            }
5663            var elementType = resolveType(pParams[0], cm2.getElementType(), cm.getElementType());
5664            if (elementType.isObject())
5665               return cm2;
5666            return new ClassMeta<>(cm2, null, null, elementType);
5667         }
5668
5669         // Handle @BeanProp(elementType=) for BeanSupplier, BeanConsumer, BeanChannel, and Stream properties.
5670         if (isNotVoid(beanp.elementType()) && (cm2.isIterable() || cm2.isStream())) {
5671            var elementType = resolveClassMeta(beanp.elementType(), typeVarImpls);
5672            if (! elementType.isObject())
5673               return new ClassMeta<>(cm2, null, null, elementType);
5674         }
5675
5676         return cm2;
5677      }
5678
5679      return cm;
5680   }

5698   /**
5699    * Finds the type parameters for a parameterized type.
5700    *
5701    * @param o The generic type.
5702    * @param c The raw class.
5703    * @return The array of {@link ClassMeta} for each type parameter, or an empty array if parameters cannot be resolved.
5704    */
5705   final ClassMeta[] findParameters(Type o, Class c) {
5706      if (o == null)
5707         o = c;
5708
5709      // Loop until we find a ParameterizedType
5710      if (! (o instanceof ParameterizedType)) {
5711         while (nn(c)) {
5712            o = c.getGenericSuperclass();
5713            if (!(o instanceof ParameterizedType))
5714               o = Arrays.stream(c.getGenericInterfaces()).filter(t -> t instanceof ParameterizedType).findFirst().orElse(null);
5715            if (o instanceof ParameterizedType)
5716               break;
5717            c = c.getSuperclass();
5718         }
5719      }
5720
5721      if (o instanceof ParameterizedType o2 && neq(o2.getRawType(), Enum.class)) {
5722         var l = new LinkedList<ClassMeta<?>>();
5723         for (var pt2 : o2.getActualTypeArguments()) {
5724            if (pt2 instanceof WildcardType || pt2 instanceof TypeVariable)
5725               return new ClassMeta[0];
5726            l.add(resolveClassMeta(pt2, null));
5727         }
5728         if (l.isEmpty())
5729            return new ClassMeta[0];
5730         return l.toArray(new ClassMeta[l.size()]);
5731      }
5732
5733      return new ClassMeta[0];
5734   }
5735
5736   final ClassMeta resolveClassMeta(Type o, TypeVariables typeVars) {
5737      if (o == null)
5738         return null;
5739
5740      if (o instanceof ClassMeta<?> o2) {
5741
5742         // This classmeta could have been created by a different context.
5743         // Need to re-resolve it to pick up ObjectSwaps and stuff on this context.
5744         if (o2.getMarshallingContext() == this)
5745            return o2;
5746         if (o2.isMap())
5747            return getClassMeta(o2.inner(), o2.getKeyType(), o2.getValueType());
5748         if (o2.isCollection() || o2.isOptional())
5749            return getClassMeta(o2.inner(), o2.getElementType());
5750         return getClassMeta(o2.inner());
5751      }
5752
5753      // Handle ClassInfo by extracting the underlying Type
5754      if (o instanceof ClassInfo o2) {
5755         return resolveClassMeta(o2.innerType(), typeVars);
5756      }
5757
5758      var c = TypeVariables.resolve(o, typeVars);
5759
5760      // This can happen when trying to resolve the "E getFirst()" method on LinkedList, whose type is a TypeVariable
5761      // These should just resolve to Object.
5762      if (c == null)
5763         return object();
5764
5765      var rawType = getClassMeta(c);
5766
5767      // If this is a Map or Collection, and the parameter types aren't part
5768      // of the class definition itself (e.g. class AddressBook extends List<Person>),
5769      // then we need to figure out the parameters.
5770      if (rawType.isMap() || rawType.isCollection() || rawType.isOptional()) {
5771         var params = findParameters(o, c);
5772         if (params.length == 0)
5773            return rawType;
5774         if (rawType.isMap()) {
5775            if (params.length != 2 || (params[0].isObject() && params[1].isObject()))
5776               return rawType;
5777            return new ClassMeta(rawType, params[0], params[1], null);
5778         }
5779         if (rawType.isCollection() || rawType.isOptional()) {
5780            if (params.length != 1 || params[0].isObject())
5781               return rawType;
5782            return new ClassMeta(rawType, null, null, params[0]);
5783         }
5784      }
5785
5786      if (rawType.isArray() && o instanceof GenericArrayType o2) {
5787         var elementType = resolveClassMeta(o2.getGenericComponentType(), typeVars);
5788         return new ClassMeta(rawType, null, null, elementType);
5789      }
5790
5791      return rawType;
5792   }
5793
5794   /*
5795    * Resolves the 'genericized' class meta at the specified position in the ClassMeta array.
5796    */
5797   private ClassMeta<?> getTypedClassMeta(ClassMeta<?>[] c, int pos) {
5798      var cm = c[pos++];
5799      if (cm.isCollection() || cm.isOptional()) {
5800         var ce = c.length == pos ? object() : getTypedClassMeta(c, pos);
5801         return (ce.isObject() ? cm : new ClassMeta(cm, null, null, ce));
5802      } else if (cm.isMap()) {
5803         var ck = c.length == pos ? object() : c[pos++];
5804         var cv = c.length == pos ? object() : getTypedClassMeta(c, pos);
5805         return (ck.isObject() && cv.isObject() ? cm : new ClassMeta(cm, ck, cv, null));
5806      }
5807      return cm;
5808   }
5809
5810
5811   private ClassMeta<?> resolveType(Type...t) {
5812      for (var tt : t) {
5813         if (nn(tt)) {
5814            var cm = getClassMeta(tt);
5815            if (tt != cmObject)
5816               return cm;
5817         }
5818      }
5819      return cmObject;
5820   }
